name: Enkou Shounen
source:
In this world, money is everything.
I know nothing of more worth than money, nor do I want to.
It's impossible to live without it, so it's obvious how important it is.
Greed makes people ugly, you say? Shut up, go kill yourself.
"There are things more important than money"? "There are things money can't buy"?
What are you, an idiot? That's just empty talk.
What's wrong with wanting money? Or with making it?
Money is justice. It is everything.

Raised in a poor family, Nagi uses his good looks to earn money through paid dating in Shinjuku. Shizuka, Nagi's childhood friend, wants him to quit...
